grh_22e4a38f9112453ac33e.title: The Country of the Blind -Edmond O Brien
paragraphs: Mountain guide Nunez survives a fall into an isolated Andean valley whose inhabitants have been blind for generations and cannot comprehend his claims about sight. grh_222881e57db952877a42.title: Rose Marie
paragraphs: Rose Marie loves Jim Kenyon, but wealthy Edward Hawley wants her and exploits a murder to remove his rival.
